ingestion_recommendations.index_units: Each passage string (English and/or translated) as a document
ingestion_recommendations.gold_for_eval: is_selected == 1 within the example's passage list
ingestion_recommendations.cleaning: Strip leading punctuation from Eng_Query; drop empty Answer/Eng_Answer; dedupe identical passage text across queries when building a global corpus
ingestion_recommendations.chunking: Start from passage-level units; apply sentence/semantic/sliding-window when passage length stats show multi-sentence content
ingestion_recommendations.query_types_for_routing: DESCRIPTION / ENTITY / NUMERIC / LOCATION / PERSON etc. from query_type, plus length/complexity heuristics → FAST / ACCURATE / DEEP
